messages:
ellie: Quick broadcast — release freeze next Wed 03:00-09:00 UTC. This is a soft freeze for non-critical infra changes and a hard freeze for user-facing schema/contract changes. Please plan rollouts accordingly. :calendar:

mike: Thanks. Is the rolling blackout window still in effect for Dedicated?

ellie: Yes — Dedicated + Hosted both observe the blackout. We added a delegated canary handoff process so team leads can run canaries without paging infra. Details below.

soren: TL;DR for on-call: what do we get paged for during the freeze? :rotating_light:

ops-oncall: Only P0/P1s and infra security alerts. Anything causing >5% error rate or >2x latency for 15m will page.

ellie: Delegated canary checklist (run by owning team, infra still monitors):
```
- Assign a release owner and a delegated approver (must be a senior eng)
- Canary percentage: start 5% -> 25% in 15m steps
- Canary duration per step: 15m (min)
- Success criteria: error rate delta < 0.3% and p95 latency delta < 20%
- If any step fails, immediate rollback and @ops-oncall notify
- Run smoke tests: /ci smoke --env=canary
- Record canary run in #release-canaries with logs link
```

tara: Add note: if you need a freeze-exception (hotfix), file the lightweight exception form and ping me + @mike. Exceptions close automatically after 6h unless approved.

mike: We'll be gating schema migrations entirely — use feature flags for runtime changes during the freeze. No direct DB migrations without infra-approved maintenance window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job queued: release/2026.03.25/feature-xyz -> 5% target. Logs: https://ci.reddemo/abc123

ellie: Operational changes summary to copy into your team docs: 1) rolling blackout windows will reduce cross-team blast radius, 2) delegated canaries mean team owners can run controlled canaries, 3) on-call still handles critical incidents, 4) schema changes blocked unless exception granted.

soren: Sounds good. I'll update release playbooks and add a short blurb for the SRE runbook.

tara: Reminder: if you plan any model-serving config or quant changes, drop a note in #eng-runtime 48h before freeze so we can pre-validate kernels.

ellie: Thanks all — filing the formal freeze notice in the release calendar and sending an org-wide summary this afternoon. Ping me for clarifications. :thumbsup:
